description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Pixels`, which validates pixel values in HTML attributes. It ensures the pixel value is a valid integer, handles optional maximum bounds, and converts the value accordingly.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Pixels
classes.description: A class for validating pixel attribute values according to the HTML specification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally sets the maximum allowed pixel value.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes a pixel value string, ensuring it is a number between 0 and the specified maximum.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the class, optionally with a maximum pixel value.
